task.title: Scheduled GitHub Action: build benchmarks for requested formats
task.description:
## Why
The benchmark crawl stays in Python because it runs too long for a Worker and already works. It needs to run on a schedule and publish its results.

## Steps
1. Add a scheduled workflow that reads the most requested missing formats from the site.
2. For each, run the existing Python pool crawl and benchmark build.
3. Upload the resulting benchmark file to R2. It holds aggregate tables only, so it is safe to publish.
4. Refresh the existing benchmarks once a season.
5. Limit each run to a few formats so the crawl stays inside the workflow time limit and Sleeper's rate limit.

## Done when
- A format requested by users gets a benchmark in R2 without anyone running the crawl by hand.
- The next report for that format shows percentiles.
